build_system: Vite 5.4, npm workspaces (root + frontend + backend), tsc strict mode with noUncheckedIndexedAccess
test_framework: No test runner configured in frontend; validation is via tsc typecheck
build_command: Cannot run in sandbox (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY - no node_modules). Validate via AST/manual review.
test_command: Cannot run in sandbox. Verify code compiles by inspection (no implicit any, correct literal types).
verification_instructions: 1. Ensure all TypeScript is strict-mode compliant (no implicit any, proper literal types with 'as const'). 2. Ensure no new imports from packages not in package.json. 3. Verify all lucide-react icons used are valid exports.
setup_instructions: npm install in root (not possible in sandbox)
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY - no npm install, no external network. Must use only pre-existing dependencies (lucide-react, react, react-router-dom, zustand, chart.js, react-chartjs-2). Cannot run tsc or vite. Validate by code inspection. Previous deploy failed on TS errors - be extremely careful with types.
contribution_requirements: All TypeScript must compile with strict + noUncheckedIndexedAccess. Use 'as const' for literal type assertions. Use existing Icon component wrapper. Follow existing CSS layer pattern.
key_patterns: Icon wrapper at components/Icon.tsx (always use <Icon icon={X} size={N} />). i18n store at stores/i18n.store.ts with useI18nStore hook. UI store at stores/ui.store.ts. LangToggle in lib/i18n.ts. CSS layers: tokens.css -> base.css -> components.css -> world-class.css -> global-icon.css -> visual-final-polish.css. Pages use 'page' class wrapper with page-header, page-title-block pattern.
directory_structure: frontend/src/components/ (shared components), frontend/src/pages/ (route pages), frontend/src/stores/ (zustand stores), frontend/src/styles/ (CSS layers), frontend/src/lib/ (utilities), frontend/src/hooks/ (custom hooks)
